title: Account Executive
jobDescription:
About Attentive.ai Attentive.ai is a fast-growing vertical Saa S firm backed by leading global investors, including Insight Partners, Info Edge Ventures, Vertex Ventures, Partners, Tenacity Ventures and Peak XV (Surge). Fresh off our Series B raise and a proven foundation in our AI-based platform
- Beam AI, we’re now expanding into a fully automated software ecosystem with AI-powered workflows for estimating, bidding, and improved collaboration for the construction and field services industries across the US & Canada. Our mission is to help businesses automate preconstruction workflows, improve operations, and drive revenue through simple, powerful, industry-focused products. Job Description: The ideal candidate is an energetic self-starter with the ability to identify influencers and key decision makers within accounts and effectively engage with US based customers. The candidate will proactively nurture leads by responding to inbound interests and targeted outbound prospects, will qualify for leads based on pre-set criteria and will set up meetings with qualified customers, and then take them to closure. Responsibilities of the

ROLE:
Develop and execute a sales strategy to identify and close new customers. Build and manage a sales pipeline, tracking leads and opportunities through each stage of the sales process. Develop and maintain relationships with key decision-makers in target accounts, using consultative selling techniques to understand their business needs and how our platform can help them achieve their goals. Negotiate and close deals with customers, ensuring that the terms of each deal are favorable for both the customer and Attentive.ai Collaborate with our product and marketing teams to ensure that our offerings meet the needs of our customers and are well-positioned in the market. Maintain a strong understanding of our offering and the construction industry, and stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices. Requirements for the

ROLE:
2 + Years' relevant experience in selling B2B software/Saa S products. Experience in North American markets preferred Bachelor's degree is must Experience in Saa S AE roles will be preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluent American English Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work

title: Customer Success Manager
jobDescription:
About Attentive.ai: Attentive.ai is a fast-growing vertical Saa S start-up, funded by Peak XV (Surge), Infoedge, Vertex Ventures, Tenacity & Insight Partner that provides innovative software solutions for the landscape, paving & construction industries in the United States. Our mission is to help businesses in this space improve their operations and grow their revenue through our simple & easy-to-use software platform. We're looking for a dynamic individual to join our team and help us drive retention, sales and grow our customer base. Job Description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual to join our team as a Customer Success Manager. An ideal candidate will have 3+ years of experience in customer success in a related field (B2B Saa S, Software etc.). As CSM, you will be responsible for driving onboarding, training and support for customers of Beam AI, our construction takeoff product. This role may include a travel component for visiting customers onsite in the US and Canada. Responsibilities of the

ROLE:
• Customer Onboarding: Oversee the customer onboarding process to ensure it's efficient, scalable, and tailored to different customer segments. • Product Adoption and Usage: Implement strategies to drive product adoption and usage, ensuring customers can leverage the full value of the solution. • Upsell Motion: Drive measurable revenue expansion by proactively identifying and closing upsell opportunities across your portfolio. • Account Management and Renewals: Manage key customer accounts to build strong relationships. Work on strategies for renewals and to prevent churn by identifying at-risk customers early and addressing their concerns. • Feedback Loop and Product Improvement: Gather customer feedback and insights. Work closely with the product team to inform product development and improvements based on customer needs and feedback. • Customer Advocacy and Engagement: Promote customer advocacy by identifying opportunities for case studies, testimonials, and referrals. Work with the marketing team to engage with the customer community through events, webinars, and forums. • Metrics and Performance Analysis: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) for customer success, such as customer satisfaction scores (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), renewal rates, and churn rate for your accounts. Requirements for the

ROLE:
• 3+ years of experience in customer success in a related field (B2B Saa S, Software etc.) • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including experience in building strong internal and external relationships • Track record of customer facing roles in a fast-paced dynamic environment is preferred • An ideal candidate should be empathic, display tact and poise under pressure • Passion for helping customers succeed • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills • Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure in a fluid environment • Open to start-up and evening shift (US business hours) If you're an experienced Customer Success Manager looking to join a fast-growing start-up we want to hear from you!

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobDescription:
About Attentive.ai: Attentive.ai is a fast-growing vertical Saa S start-up, funded by Insight Partners, Peak XV (Surge), Infoedge, Tenacity and Vertex Ventures, that provides innovative software solutions for the landscape, paving & construction industries in the United States. Our mission is to help businesses in this space improve their operations and grow their revenue through our simple & easy-to-use software platform. We're looking for a dynamic individual to join our team and help us drive retention, sales and grow our customer base. Job Description: This Customer Success role at BEAM AI is ideal for engineers, estimators, or project managers from mechanical, civil, electrical, or construction backgrounds who want to transition into a client-facing role. Acting as the technical expert, you’ll bridge communication between customers and the estimating team while driving adoption and success. It’s a great opportunity to leverage your technical knowledge, enhance customer relationships, and be part of a dynamic team disrupting the construction software industry. Proficient at CSA (Civil-Structural-Architectural) trades & MEP trades. In-depth understanding of trades across the CSI master-format. Responsibilities of the

ROLE:
Lead and optimize customer onboarding to ensure efficiency and scalability. Drive product adoption and usage, enabling customers to realize full value from Beam AI. Manage key accounts, strengthen relationships, and proactively address churn risks while driving renewals. Represent Beam AI on customer calls, clarifying technical queries and communicating requirements to the estimating team. Track and analyze customer success metrics (CSAT, NPS, renewals, churn) to improve outcomes. Identify and execute upsell opportunities, acting as a strategic advisor to accounts. Foster customer advocacy through case studies, testimonials, and referrals. Requirements for the

ROLE:
Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Construction, or Electrical Engineering, or relevant experience in construction estimating. 3+ years of experience in estimating, project management, or client-facing roles particularly for US / Canada customers. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships. Empathy, tact, and professionalism under pressure. Passion for customer success and delivering value. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to meet deadlines and adapt in a fast-paced, fluid environment. Willingness to work in a start-up setting and evening shift (aligned to US business hours). Confidence in representing the company on customer calls and explaining technical details clearly.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobDescription:
About Us
- Attentive.ai is a leading provider of landscape and property management software powered by cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI). Our software is designed to optimize workflows and help businesses scale up effortlessly in the outdoor services industry. Our Automeasure software caters to landscaping, snow removal, paving maintenance, and facilities maintenance businesses, while our Accelerate software provides end-to-end solutions for all commercial landscape maintenance and construction jobs through automated workflows. Trusted by top US and Canadian sales teams, Attentive.ai is proudly supported by renowned investors, including Sequoia Surge, Info Edge Ventures, Vertex Ventures, Tenacity Ventures & Insight Partner. Overview: We are seeking a motivated Forward Deployed Engineer with excellent communication skills and a background in mechanical, civil, electrical or construction engineering or construction sales. This role is ideal for an engineer/construction sales associate looking to transition into a dynamic software sales focused position. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting our sales team, acting as the technical expert to facilitate communication between the customer and the estimating team, clarifying technical details, and ensuring seamless operations in alignment with US timings.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Communication Facilitation: Represent the organization on customer calls to clarify technical queries and provide detailed explanations of our offerings. Collaborate with sales representatives to understand their needs and effectively communicate product updates and construction knowledge. Create and maintain clear and concise communication channels, ensuring vital information reaches the sales force promptly. Develop training materials, presentations, and documentation to assist in conveying complex technical information to sales professionals. Technical Expertise: Utilize your engineering background to comprehend intricate technical details of our products or services. Translate technical jargon into comprehensible content for sales personnel, enhancing their ability to articulate product benefits to potential clients. Communicate customer requirements clearly to the estimating team Contribute to product development by capturing and evangelizing needs expressed by the client. Sales Support: Assist in the execution of sales strategies by providing valuable insights garnered from technical expertise. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as operations, product, and customer support and the sales team. Ensure success in enterprise pilots with prospective customers Time Zone Alignment: Maintain availability and flexibility to work within US timings to ensure effective communication and support for the sales team based in those time zones.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Should be comfortable with Night Shifts (US Time Zone) A degree in mechanical, civil, construction, or electrical engineering or experience in construction sales Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify technical information for a non-technical audience. Eagerness to transition into a SME role and contribute proactively to the sales team's success. Ability to represent the organization on customer calls, clarifying technical details effectively. Ability to adapt to US timings and work collaboratively across different time zones. Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize assignments effectively. This role presents an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual with an engineering background to leverage their technical knowledge in a sales-focused environment. If you are passionate about communication and , and seek a challenging yet rewarding career disrupting the construction software industry, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our dynamic team.
